sources.title: A Clockwork Theory

sources.supported_claim: Standard clockwork separates a protected zero mode and gears and suppresses its endpoint coupling. Our previous full-rank vector chain and the present accidental Higgs phase are distinct objects.

sources.title: Axions in a highly protected gauge symmetry model
sources.authors: Q. Bonnefoy, E. Dudas, S. Pokorski
sources.read_scope_this_turn: Introduction and Sections 2.1–2.3, equations 2.1–2.7; additional displayed Section 3 equations not relied upon
sources.supported_claim: An abelian quiver can leave an accidental Goldstone mode; the first phase-breaking invariant has exponentially large degree and suppresses its mass for field amplitudes below the cutoff. This is not a proof of the supersymmetric paired-field mass factors derived here.
